checks.result: 60-odd checks, ALL NUMBERS RECONCILE. Written by the authoring agent to reconcile every headline number in prose against the data file it comes from; it caught two stale numbers in its own route file before delivery (an efficiency pair quoted from a superseded arm, and a '5x to 30x' range whose own data spans 7.6x to 66x).

checks.command: python3 (ad hoc, run by the integrating session)
checks.result: 49 routes, 10 scales. Zero routes at a scale the page does not declare, zero routes matching no outcome class (a route the filter hides is a route nobody reads), zero illegal read-levels, every renderer-required field present on every route and scale. 89 evidence entries, 35 distinct PMIDs (the author reported 36; recounted here as 35).

checks.name: Source verification of the page's lead claim
checks.command: WebFetch of PMC6994979 via r.jina.ai after a direct fetch was CAPTCHA-blocked
checks.result: Verified verbatim in Kriegman et al. 2020 Materials and Methods: 'This resulted in highly performant but nontransferable designs'; 'on average, 47% of the gait cycle' without contact; the fix 'incorporating first-order hydrodynamics' via increased buoyancy and 'applying a drag force to each voxel face'; ground contact '93.3% of their evaluation period' against 'just 52.7% on the first pass'. One inference by the authoring agent (that the first pass used gravity-plus-friction specifically) was NOT supported by the source, which says only 'on land', and is marked as inference.
